Apply to become an astronaut!

We've opened applications to join NASA's astronaut corps, who will expand the frontiers of discovery in low Earth orbit, on the Moon, and beyond. Check our link in bio for the details.

#NASA #Astronaut #JobSearch

Galaxy in bloom

Data from our Hubble, Chandra, and Spitzer telescopes blend to reveal a starburst galaxy with colorful areas coming out from its core like flower petals. Scientists think the shape may come from a close encounter with a nearby galaxy.

#NASA #Galaxy #Flower

This glowing cloud is a dwarf galaxy, a type of galaxy containing anywhere from a few thousand stars to hundreds of millions. This small galaxy, photographed by @NASAHubble, is located 12.5 million light-years away from Earth.
 
#NASA #Hubble #Galaxy

Spacewalk or moonwalk? 🌝

We're playing "This or That" with our current class of astronaut candidates. Could you be one of our next astronauts? Get your application in by Dec. 3.

See our link in bio to learn more!

#NASA #Astronaut #ToTheMoon

How’s that for a starburst?

Found in this distant spiral galaxy is a giant star prone to mysterious outbursts. Thanks to @NASAChandraXray, scientists identified the culprit behind the eruptions—a hidden companion to the volatile star.
 
#NASA #Chandra #Galaxy

The sounds of Earth have traveled nearly a light-day away.
 
On Sept. 5, 1977, our Voyager 1 spacecraft lifted off with the Golden Record—which contains sounds, pictures, and music from Earth.
 
Next week, Voyager 1 will be exactly one light-day (16 billion miles) away from Earth, farther than any human-made object has ever gone. Join us after sunset on Nov. 17 to “Shine Bright” for this milestone. Check the link in our bio for more info!
 
#NASA #Voyager #GoldenRecord

Tethys and Dione showed up for the group photo!

In addition to the two moons shown here, Saturn has a whole entourage of natural satellites—more than any other planet in our solar system. As of now, the ringed planet has 293 confirmed moons.

#NASA #Saturn #Moon

This is what American ambition looks like. 🇺🇸🚀
Under the Trump Administration, ambition is back. Momentum is back. Leadership is back. NASA is BACK. 🚀🇺🇸

Two astronauts and two Thunderbirds walk into an air show 🚀✈️

We teamed up with NASA astronauts Cmdr. Jack “Radio” Hathaway and Lt. Col. Nichole “Vapor” Stilwell for the ultimate Q&A. From the F-16 cockpit to the Dragon capsule, hear what it takes to perform at an elite level, no matter the altitude 🌎

#AmericasTeam #Thunderbirds #BlindTrust

American ambition at full throttle. 🇺🇸

An incredible first day of MAX POWER at @NASAKennedy with @airdotshow, and we’re not done yet. This is just a taste of what’s ahead with Cape Week.
